extracted.intended_audience: staff and stakeholders of the Italian Patent Office (UIBM), patent practitioners, policy makers, researchers and other users of national patent statistics
extracted.subtask_description: Annual statistical and procedural report (UIBM Directorate General for the Protection of Industrial Property) summarising filings, procedural steps, timing, final decisions and applicant demographics for patents, utility models, EP national validations and related IP procedures in Italy for 2021. Includes counts, trends and procedural timing rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: N. Filings (patents - industrial inventions)
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of patent filings (industrial invention) per quarter and total (tables comparing quarterly data from 2019 to 2021).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to measure volume of patent applications and to detect year-on-year growth trends (the report notes a further increase in patent applications in 2021 confirming a medium-term growth trend).

rubrics_metrics.name: Trend patent filings (2010-2021)
rubrics_metrics.description: Graph and numbers showing the trend of Italian patent filings over the last 11 years (2010-2021).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides multi-year context to assess growth, peaks and declines in filings; used for policy and resource planning.

rubrics_metrics.name: Novelty search phase — dossiers sent to EPO
rubrics_metrics.description: Patent applications (first filings) are sent to the European Patent Office (EPO) for the prior art search after preliminary examination and dossier preparation in English by UIBM. The report gives quarterly counts of dossiers sent to the EPO (2019-2021).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Counts measure the workload sent for EPO search and are linked to UIBM's preliminary processing capacity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Timing requirement for sending dossiers to EPO
rubrics_metrics.description: "Applications must be sent to the EPO within the 5th month from the filing date, except for applications that do not meet formal or substantial validity requirements, according to Italian Patent law."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedural requirement governing when UIBM sends dossiers for EPO prior-art searches; exception for files failing formal/substantial validity checks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patenting procedures — final decision categories (patents)
rubrics_metrics.description: Final decisions adopted closing each patenting procedure, enumerated as: Grants; Conversion art. 84 CPI; Not admissible; Refusals; Withdrawals (with quarterly and total counts).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These categories are used as mutually exclusive procedure outcomes and for statistical reporting of dispositions of patent applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Counts of final decisions (patents)
rubrics_metrics.description: Quarterly and total counts for each final decision category for patents (e.g., totals: Grants 7248; Conversion 127; Not admissible 89; Refusals 2006; Withdrawals 602 in 2021).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enables analysis of grant rates, refusal rates, and other outcome distributions over time.

rubrics_metrics.name: Utility models — N. Filings
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of patent applications for utility models per quarter and total comparing 2019-2021 (tables and trend graph).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tracks the volume and trend of utility model filings separately from patents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Trend of utility models applications (2011-2021)
rubrics_metrics.description: Graph showing the trend over the last 11 years for utility model applications (2011-2021).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Shows long-term changes in utility model use, helping to inform policy or operational decisions for this protection type.

rubrics_metrics.name: Utility models — final decision categories
rubrics_metrics.description: Final decisions for utility models enumerated as: Grants; Conversions art. 84 CPI; Not admissible; Refusals; Withdrawals (quarterly and total counts provided).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to compute outcome distributions for utility models and compare with patents.

rubrics_metrics.name: European patent national validations — requests
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts of requests for EP validation in Italy (quarterly data for 2019-2021) and total EP validation filings (e.g., totals such as 36192 over period).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to track how many European patents are validated in Italy and trends over time (the report notes a slight decrease after the 2019 peak).

rubrics_metrics.name: EP validation procedures — final decisions
rubrics_metrics.description: Final decision categories for EP national validations in Italy: Validations; Refusals; Withdrawals (with quarterly and aggregated counts for 2021).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Shows national-level dispositions on EP validations and supports monitoring validation volumes and refusal/withdrawal incidence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Supplementary Protection Certificates (SPCs), New Plant Varieties (NPV) and Semi-Conductors Topographies (SCT) — applications
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts of applications for SPCs, NPVs and SCTs by quarter and total (year 2021 table).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tracks filings for other IP rights beyond patents/utility models; used for aggregate workload calculation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Final decisions for SPCs/NPV/SCT (SPC final decisions)
rubrics_metrics.description: Final decisions reported for SPCs and related categories: Grants; Refusals; Withdrawals; Revoked (quarterly and total counts for 2021).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to measure disposition and stability of SPC/NPV/SCT protections (including revocations).

rubrics_metrics.name: Total applications with UIBM (aggregated breakdown)
rubrics_metrics.description: Aggregated totals of applications managed by UIBM broken down by type: Patents, Utility Models, EP National Validations, Receiving Office: PCT+EP, SPCs/NPV/SCT and overall total (quarterly and yearly totals provided).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides a comprehensive view of the Office's total filing workload and composition by protection type.

rubrics_metrics.name: Total final decisions (aggregate across procedure types)
rubrics_metrics.description: Aggregated counts of final decisions across procedure types (patents, utility models, EP validations, CCP/CCPF etc.) with breakdown by decision category (Grants, Conversions, Not admissible, Refusals, Withdrawals, Revoked).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used for high-level performance metrics, e.g., overall grant rate and total dispositions in the year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicants' nationality (patent applicants)
rubrics_metrics.description: Analysis/counts of applicant nationality for patent applications (an application may have more than one applicant), with Italy vs Other breakdown and counts for specific foreign origins (Germany, Switzerland, China, United States, Taiwan, Sweden, Japan, France, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to assess domestic vs foreign participation and to identify major foreign applicant countries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Geographical origin of Italian applicants
rubrics_metrics.description: Geographical breakdown of Italian applicants by region (North-West, North-East, Centre, South, Islands) with counts and percentage shares; compared with ISTAT geographical origin data.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Useful for regional analysis of innovation activity and policymaking targeted to regions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application type and priority claim
rubrics_metrics.description: Classification of applications by type (Ordinary, Contemporary, Conversion, Divisional, Conversion EP) and by priority claim (Priority YES/NO), with counts and percentages (e.g., priority rates).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to understand filing strategies (priority claims) and procedural categories which affect processing and examination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Receiving office breakdown (EP and PCT filings)
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts and trends for filings where the receiving office was EP or PCT (quarterly totals for 2019-2021).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tracks international filing routes and workload associated with different receiving offices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Average time for sending dossiers to EPO for novelty search
rubrics_metrics.description: Processing time statistics for sending dossiers to EPO (the report provides counts within/over 5 months and within/over 9 months, and total dossiers sent per quarter/year).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Monitors compliance with the 5-month timing requirement and overall processing speed; used to measure operational performance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Times receipting Search Report / Months from filing metrics
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts and percentages showing how many search reports were receipted and distribution in months from filing (e.g., 'Within 9 months' vs 'Over 9 months').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Measures downstream timing performance after search reports are issued and helps identify delays.

rubrics_metrics.name: Final decisions by quarter (detailed time series)
rubrics_metrics.description: Quarterly time series counts for each decision type (Grant, Refusal, Withdrawals, Conversion, Inadmissible) for patents and utility models (detailed tables by quarter and year).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enables temporal analysis of decisions to detect seasonal or operational patterns in dispositions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Plant Varieties (PV) and Semi-Conductor Topographies (SCT) — application trends
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts and quarterly trends for Plant Varieties and Semi-Conductor Topography applications (small numbers shown for 2019-2021).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Included to capture full spectrum of IP filings handled by the Office, even lower-volume categories.
